name: Branislav Ivanović
bio: Branislav's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands. A former military police officer, he developed a keen eye for detail and risk assessment during his service. His transition to motorsport security was a natural fit, starting with local rally events before moving into karting. He believes in proactive security measures, focusing on prevention rather than reaction. Branislav's rigorous approach, honed by his military background, is what sets him apart. He emphasizes discipline and preparedness, ensuring the team's assets and personnel are always protected.

physical.description: Branislav is a powerfully built man with a stern, watchful gaze.

quirks: Always polishes his boots before a race.
Insists on security briefings being conducted in Serbian (translated for non-speakers).
Carries a worn, leather-bound notebook filled with potential security threats.
